summary: aclade-agent executes remote-server-issued shell commands and file operations on installer host
details: The CLI in dist/index.js polls https://aclade.com/api/connector/poll?token=... for 'tasks' and dispatches them to local handlers including execute_bash (child_process.spawn with shell:true), read_file, write_file, and list_directory_recursive. Command output and file contents are POSTed back to https://aclade.com/api/connector/respond. Whoever controls that endpoint can run arbitrary shell commands and read or write arbitrary files on any host running the agent, with the privileges of the user who launched it. Because execution is gated on the user starting the CLI (not on npm install or require), the exposure fires when the tool is run, but the control channel is a remote server rather than local user input.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
